##: NOT submittable as-is. This manifest has no bin/shortcuts/installer/pre_install stanza,
so `scoop install sift` would only cache Sift-Setup.exe (renamed dl.exe) with nothing
runnable — no shim, no shortcut, no invocation of the installer.
The usual Expand-7zipArchive pre_install workaround for electron-builder NSIS apps (e.g.
ScoopInstaller/Extras obsidian.json) depends on electron-builder's one-click NSIS packaging
(a single embedded 7z at a fixed path). Sift sets nsis.oneClick: false (assisted, multi-page
installer), so that trick does not apply, and there is no established Scoop pattern for
assisted-mode NSIS installers — see ScoopInstaller/Extras#1531 (open since 2018, unresolved).
Do not open the Extras PR until a real install stanza exists and `scoop install sift`
has been verified to produce a working, launchable app on a clean machine.
